summary_ja: 内部格付手法の使用開始前に、連結自己資本規制比率の予備計算と予備計算報告書の作成・届出・提出を行う義務を定める。
summary_en: Requires a company seeking approval to preliminarily calculate its consolidated capital adequacy ratio on the internal ratings-based approach, and to prepare, notify and submit interim and annual preliminary calculation reports.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company seeking the approval under Article 116 for the use of the internal ratings-based approach shall, from the business year preceding the business year in which the date on which it intends to begin using the internal ratings-based approach falls, preliminarily calculate the consolidated capital adequacy ratio on the basis of the internal ratings-based approach for which it seeks approval, and prepare an interim preliminary calculation report for that preceding business year (meaning a document stating matters concerning the operational status of the internal rating system (meaning the internal rating system provided in Article 157, paragraph (1); the same applies hereinafter in this Subsection) from the first day of the business year to the last day of the interim period of that business year and the status of the consolidated capital adequacy ratio as of the last day of the interim period of that business year; the same applies hereinafter in this Article) and a preliminary calculation report for that preceding business year (meaning a document stating matters concerning the operational status of the internal rating system for the business year and the status of the consolidated capital adequacy ratio as of the last day of that business year; the same applies hereinafter in this Article); provided, however, that this does not apply where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company that becomes the parent company of an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach through a merger, share exchange, share transfer or other reorganization carried out by that Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach seeks the approval under Article 116 for the use of the internal ratings-based approach, if that reorganization does not materially affect the continuity of the calculation of the consolidated capital adequacy ratio based on the internal ratings-based approach and the Ultimate Designated Parent Company seeking the approval is able to prepare documents equivalent to the interim preliminary calculation report and the preliminary calculation report based on the figures, etc. before that reorganization (where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company is newly established by share transfer, documents based on the figures, etc. of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach referred to in the same item that becomes its subsidiary).

An Ultimate Designated Parent Company intending to carry out the preliminary calculation of the consolidated capital adequacy ratio provided in the preceding paragraph shall file a notification with the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency, attaching to a document stating the matters listed in the items of paragraph (1) of the preceding Article documents equivalent to the documents listed in the items of paragraph (2) of that Article.

Prior to submitting the application for approval, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company shall submit to the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency, within three months after the end of the period covered by each report, the interim preliminary calculation report and the preliminary calculation report under paragraph (1), attaching to them a document stating the matters listed in the items of paragraph (1) of the preceding Article and documents equivalent to the documents listed in the items of paragraph (2) of that Article.

In applying the preceding three paragraphs where the date on which it intends to begin using the internal ratings-based approach is on or after the day following the last day of the interim period of the relevant business year, the phrase "interim preliminary calculation report for that preceding business year" in paragraph (1) shall be read as "interim preliminary calculation report for the business year in which the date on which it intends to begin use falls".
